issues.explanation: Deletes all existing routes (/, home, onboarding, dashboard, settings, membros, auth, password reset) and replaces the current_entity group, breaking the app beyond the task.
Members tabs feature (activeTab, setActiveTab, tablist, invite gating) has no diff at all.
Queues view renders only the list and create button with a placeholder comment; detail, rename, toggle-confirm and access modals required by the task are absent.
Queues mount stores the entity without authorizing create on Queue, so employees are not denied in the component.
Serve mount does not authorize view on the entity and no action authorizes or validates, leaving authorization to route middleware that also drops verified.
openQueue and openAccess assign client-supplied ids without scoped findOrFail, violating never trust action parameters.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Routes use Route::get with a Livewire class and can:create,queue,entity / can:view,entity instead of the existing Route::livewire current_entity group, and verified middleware is lost.
getAccessQueueProperty uses findOrFail so a tampered foreign id throws instead of returning null with empty accessGrants as required.
create passes only name to CreateQueue with no slug derivation and surfaces errors under the domain field instead of mapping duplicate slug to name.
lastCalledTicketId is a writable public int and mode is an unvalidated string, so the client can overwrite served state and CallMode::from(mode) throws on tampered values.
callNext has no RateLimiter although the task requires rate-limiting successful calls per user and entity.
Serve view hardcodes English labels, never renders ui.serve_empty for foreign/missing/unauthorized queues, and builds channel keys from $ticket->channel without enum value handling.
Both nav links are placed inside @can manageSettings so employees cannot see Serve, while only Queues should be managers-only.
Lang files are added as new files with only the new keys, which would discard existing ui.php keys such as nav_settings and members_invite_title.
No #[Validate] or #[Locked], no $this->validate, no $this->authorize, and internal getCallableQueues is public instead of protected/computed.
Uses dispatchBrowserEvent, duplicate TicketStatus import, Route::get for Livewire, and leaves a stray ?> and omitted-for-brevity placeholder.
closeQueue does not reset accessQueueId/managingAccess although the task requires resetting every nested state.
No docs, PHPDoc, or CHANGELOG update despite conventions requiring docs stay in sync.

conventions.evidence: Follows Actions-for-writes (Queues.php:11-13, Serve.php:215) but has no #[Validate]/#[Locked]/authorize, uses dispatchBrowserEvent (Queues.php:63,79), Route::get for Livewire (web.php:535-538), duplicate use (Serve.php:217,220), no tests or docs.

readability.evidence: Methods are small with contract names (Queues.php:59-198, Serve.php:270-286) but serve.blade.php:409-436 hardcodes English, queues.blade.php:396-398 has placeholder comment and stray ?>, Serve.php:217,220 duplicates an import.

requirements.evidence: Contract props/methods present (Queues.php:26-33, Serve.php:228-231) but queues.blade.php:1-15 lacks all modals, Members tabs absent from diff, Serve.php:270-286 lacks rate-limit, web.php:449-532 deletes existing routes, accessQueue uses findOrFail (Queues.php:45).

scope.evidence: web.php:449-532 deletes all unrelated routes; lang/en/ui.php:1-27 and lang/pt_BR/ui.php:1-27 replace whole files; everything else serves the task.

security.evidence: No $this->authorize in Queues.php:35-38,96-198 or Serve.php:233-286; openQueue (Queues.php:90-94) and openAccess (Queues.php:164-169) trust ids; Serve.php:230 lastCalledTicketId writable; Serve.php:278 CallMode::from(mode) unvalidated.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket and Gate filtering (Serve.php:241-245) with no new layers; weighed down by legacy dispatchBrowserEvent, public getCallableQueues, duplicate import.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ or *Test.php additions; happy path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests all missing.

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve components with scoped reads and domain actions for the main paths, but deletes all existing routes, omits Members tabs and all Queues modals, skips mount authorization, validation/locking and rate-limiting, and ships no tests, so it cannot be merged.
